systemArchitectures.name: Commercial Continuous Ultra-High Pressure Supercritical CO2 Fluid High-Shear Micro-Fluidizer Nano-Emulsion Sterilization (UHPS-MFS) Industrial Skid
systemArchitectures.classification: Continuous Aseptic Ultra-High Pressure Supercritical Micro-Fluidization Skid (FDA 21 CFR § 117 FSMA cGMP / 21 CFR § 113 Low-Acid Aseptic Processing / USP <729> Globule Size in Lipid Emulsions / 3-A Sanitary Standards 63-04 & 08-17 / EHEDG Type EL Class I CIP / ASME Section VIII Div 1 & ASME B31.3 High-Pressure Process Piping)
systemArchitectures.technology: Continuous ultra-high pressure supercritical CO2 fluid micro-fluidization (P = 150 – 280 bar, shear rates γ̇ > 10⁷ s⁻¹, turbulent dissipation ε > 10⁸ W/kg) across diamond Y-type interaction micro-channels (d = 75 – 100 µm) with in-line CO2 dense-phase permeabilization, simultaneously producing sub-50 nm nano-emulsions (d_32 < 45 nm, PDI < 0.10) and non-thermal >6.0 log10 microbial and bacterial endospore sterilization without thermal degradation
systemArchitectures.cipSanitizationRating: 100% Resistant to 2.0% NaOH at 80°C, 1.5% Peracetic Acid (PAA) at 50°C, Automated Clean-in-Place (CIP) & Supercritical CO2 Sterile Depressurization Conformance

nanoEmulsionFormulations.name: Curcumin Polyphenol & Medium Chain Triglyceride (MCT) Optical Clarity Nano-Emulsion
nanoEmulsionFormulations.formulationDescription: Natural turmeric curcuminoid extract dissolved in coconut-derived MCT oil, stabilized with Quillaja saponins, engineered for optical clarity in clear functional beverages and enhanced cellular absorption.
nanoEmulsionFormulations.lipidPhase: Curcumin (95% purity, 3.5% w/w) in Caprylic/Capric MCT Oil (10.0% w/w)
nanoEmulsionFormulations.surfactantSystem: Purified Quillaja Saponins Q-Naturale (2.5% w/w) + Soy Lecithin (0.5% w/w)
nanoEmulsionFormulations.degradingAlternative: Thermal Pasteurization (75°C for 30s causing 38% curcumin degradation, cloudy turbidity, ring settling)
nanoEmulsionFormulations.regulatoryStandard: FDA GRAS 21 CFR § 184.1277 & USP <729> Method I

nanoEmulsionFormulations.name: Trans-Resveratrol & Phospholipid Hydrophobic Core Nano-Carrier
nanoEmulsionFormulations.formulationDescription: High-purity polygonum trans-resveratrol encapsulated in food-grade hydrogenated phospholipid nano-droplets to prevent photo-isomerization into inactive cis-resveratrol.
nanoEmulsionFormulations.lipidPhase: Trans-Resveratrol (99% purity, 2.8% w/w) in Virgin Olive Oil & Flaxseed Oil (8.0% w/w)
nanoEmulsionFormulations.surfactantSystem: Hydrogenated Sunflower Phosphatidylcholine (3.0% w/w) + Polysorbate-20 (0.8% w/w)
nanoEmulsionFormulations.degradingAlternative: Standard High-Pressure Homogenizer (1,200 bar, 6 passes, causing shear heat >65°C and 42% cis-isomerization)
nanoEmulsionFormulations.regulatoryStandard: FDA GRAS Notice GRN 000512 & EFSA Resveratrol Directive

nanoEmulsionFormulations.name: Citrus Sinensis Cold-Pressed Essential Oil & Quillaja Saponin Antimicrobial Nano-Dispersion
nanoEmulsionFormulations.formulationDescription: Cold-pressed citrus terpenes and d-limonene nano-emulsified for clean-label antimicrobial wash and broad-spectrum bacterial spoilage protection in cold-pressed juices.
nanoEmulsionFormulations.lipidPhase: Cold-Pressed Valencia Orange Essential Oil (95% d-Limonene, 5.0% w/w)
nanoEmulsionFormulations.surfactantSystem: Quillaja Bark Saponin Extract (2.0% w/w) + Arabic Gum (1.0% w/w)
nanoEmulsionFormulations.targetMicrobe: Salmonella enterica, Escherichia coli O157:H7 & spoilage molds
nanoEmulsionFormulations.degradingAlternative: Hot Fill Canning (90°C thermal holding boiling off terpene aroma volatiles and producing off-sulfur notes)

nanoEmulsionFormulations.name: Plant Protein Shielded Probiotic Bacterial Matrix & Spore Inactivation Modeler
nanoEmulsionFormulations.formulationDescription: Micronized yellow pea protein isolate (Pisum sativum) forming a protective amphiphilic steric corona around hydrophobic nutraceutical cores, while selective high-pressure scCO2 destroys vegetative contaminants.
nanoEmulsionFormulations.lipidPhase: Virgin Coconut Oil (6.0% w/w) + Vitamin D3/K2 Cholecalciferol (0.5% w/w)
nanoEmulsionFormulations.surfactantSystem: Enzymatically Hydrolyzed Pea Protein Isolate (3.5% w/w)
nanoEmulsionFormulations.targetMicrobe: Bacillus subtilis vegetative cells & Staphylococcus aureus
nanoEmulsionFormulations.degradingAlternative: UHT Steam Injection (138°C for 4s denaturing pea globulin proteins, protein coagulation, chalky mouthfeel)

nanoEmulsionFormulations.name: Natural Astaxanthin & Omega-3 EPA/DHA Marine Lipid Nano-Carrier
nanoEmulsionFormulations.formulationDescription: Supercritical-extracted Haematococcus astaxanthin coupled with deep-sea menhaden omega-3 triglycerides, stabilized against autoxidation by dense-phase carbon dioxide deoxygenation.
nanoEmulsionFormulations.lipidPhase: Refined Menhaden Omega-3 Fish Oil (30% EPA/DHA, 8.0% w/w) + Astaxanthin (1.5% w/w)
nanoEmulsionFormulations.surfactantSystem: Enzymatically Modified Lyso-Phosphatidylcholine (2.8% w/w) + Mixed Tocopherols (0.2% w/w)
nanoEmulsionFormulations.degradingAlternative: Rotor-Stator High Shear Mixer (Incomplete droplet breakup d > 350 nm, air incorporation causing rapid rancidity)
nanoEmulsionFormulations.regulatoryStandard: USP Monograph Marine Oil & FDA 21 CFR § 184.1472
